method: Exactly two ordinary terminal attempts through normal UI using installed Chrome and tools/visible-playtest.mjs. Learned through visible menu, operator handbook, screenshots, map, HUD and own attempts. No source, tests, prior reviews, hidden state, debug URLs or resource changes inspected.
raw_evidence: Driver actions and screenshots preserved in evidence directory; includes failed selector commands while closing recovered-record dialog.

attempts.memory_observations: Recovery by holding E succeeded after entering ring; supplies restored. Post-death recovered record opened and displayed station medic story.
attempts.combat_observations: Opening guard eliminated with rifle aimed toward optic. Patrols damaged shield and health while negotiating archive partitions. Later rifle shots did not establish another elimination.
attempts.boss: Not reached; inactive coil structure visible near spawn, active boss combat not observed.

traversal.walking: Used successfully to reach west archive; repeatedly blocked by tall partitions.
traversal.dash: Pressed during archive exit; cooldown reset later, but successful interrupt or evade not established; end screen reports 0 phase evades.
traversal.space: Pressed in terminal batch after death appears to have occurred; actual jump/vault not established.

attempts.memory_observations: Both recoveries succeeded with hold E; objective advanced and supplies/health restored. East archive approached but not recovered.
attempts.combat_observations: Opening guard eliminated using rifle; second elimination registered during rifle/pump breakout. Pump breacher selected, fired and reloaded from 3 to6 shells. Heart warden engaged but no elimination established. Incoming fire rapidly drained health during aiming and recovery.
attempts.boss: Not activated or fought; only two memories recovered.

traversal.walking: Used successfully between west archive and Heart. East approach ran into partitions and failed to reach receiver.
traversal.map_and_trace: Opened visible paused map and used held Tab trace; helped reach Heart approach.
traversal.dash: Used during breakout and Heart engagement; recharge visible but interrupt success not established; end screen0 phase evades.
traversal.space: Pressed during breakout and east entry. Changed position, but screenshots do not establish a vault or distinguish jump from vault.

strengths: Cohesive rain, wet reflective ground, teal lighting, oversized station signage and restrained HUD create a strong station atmosphere.
Opening guard instruction clearly names optic, Shift and flank options.
Recovery gives clear memory confirmation, updates objectives and restores supplies; recovered narrative remains accessible after death.
Paused map and Tab ground approach aid navigation; shield regeneration allowed a second attempt to continue after severe damage.
End screen clearly reports recovered people and combat statistics.
problems: From several archive angles, objective marker placement and distance were difficult to reconcile with walls and the receiver ring; navigation required repeated short corrections under fire.
Tall and low partitions were hard to judge for traversal from paused views; Space inputs did not provide evidence sufficient to confirm vault success.
Patrol attacks drained health quickly while I oriented and held E; small direction cues conveyed danger but did not always make source position immediately clear.
Ordinary sentinels and wardens share a fairly simple mechanical silhouette; the large optic is useful but the observed character presentation remains visibly stylized and simple beside polished UI.
Handbook contains substantial useful detail in one dense dialog; learning combat and route rules in a first attempt is demanding.
rating_basis: Scores reflect only these two failed ordinary attempts and visible presentation. Strong atmosphere and working recovery/navigation loop, with my combat exposure and navigation friction limiting progress. AAA readiness is a limited observed slice judgment, not full-game certification.
confounds: Synthetic browser-timed DOM input and automatic screenshot/Escape pauses differ substantially from continuous human play.
Long firing/movement batches exposed the operator while aiming updates occurred between screenshots; low accuracy and deaths cannot alone establish balance defects.
Screenshot capture itself can allow further simulation: attempt2 east-entry beforePause showed2 health, after showed terminal death.
Software-WebGL fallback enabled; hardware renderer and performance not certified.
No human enjoyment claim, audio assessment, hardware certification or full boss/upload assessment.
Three failed dialog selectors/timeouts were driver interaction mistakes, preserved in raw actions; retry was through normal close/archive and deploy UI.
